DEPARTMENT OF FORESTS AND WILDLIFE
NOTIFICATION
Delhi, the 13th February, 2026
F.No.27088/WFD/COT/2025-26/15990.—WHEREAS, an application ID no. 27088 on DPTA e-
Forest portal was received by the Tree Officer (West Forest Division) from Sh. Prabhat Kamal Pawan,
JGM/Project, Rail Land Development Authority, Unit No. 702-B, 7th floor, Konnectus Tower-2, DMRC
Building Ajmeri Gate, New Delhi-110002 for seeking permission under the Delhi Preservation of Trees Act,
1994 (Delhi Act 11 of 1994) (hereinafter referred to as DPTA, 1994) for transplantation / felling of 1293
trees number of trees for development of Bijwasan Railway station, Sector-21, Dwarka, New Delhi in an area
of 6.9531 hectare.
WHEREAS, the Tree Officer (West Forest Division) after due application of mind, has sought
exemption in respect of 6.9531hectare area (as per details in Annexure – A) under Section 29 of the DPTA,
1994 from applicability of Section 9 sub-section (3) of the DPTA, 1994, in view of limitation of maximum
one hectare area for considering application of tree transplantation / felling by the Tree Officer in Section 9
sub-section (3) of the DPTA, 1994.
THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994, the Lt.
Governor of National Capital Territory of Delhi, hereby, in public interest, exempts an area of 6.9531 hectare
(as perdetails in Annexure – A), from the limitation of maximum one hectare area under sub-section (3) of
Section 9 of the said Act for development of Bijwasan Railway station, Sector-21, Dwarka, New Delhi with
the following conditions:
1) This notification is being issued under Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994 only to exempt the
6.9531 hectare area (as per details in Annexure – A) from the limitation of maximum one
hectare area under sub-section (3) of Section 9 of the DPTA, 1994 for development of
Bijwasan Railway station, Sector-21, Dwarka, New Delhi as sought by the Tree Officer.
2) This notification for exemption under Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994, in any case, shall not be
considered as permission for transplantation / felling of trees under the DPTA, 1994.
3) The application for transplantation / felling of tress shall be considered and scrutinized
independently and separately by the Tree Officer (West Forest Division) under the provisions
of the DPTA, 1994, the Delhi Preservation of Trees Rules, 1996, relevant guidelines,
directions issued in this regard and all relevant court orders with due application of mind
minimizing the number of affected trees to be transplantation / felling from within the
exempted area.

By Order and in the Name of the Lt. Governor of the
National Capital Territory of Delhi,
VIJAY KUMAR BIDHURI, Secy. (Environment & Forests)
